mitigation_descriptions: Audit sudoers configurations to ensure users cannot execute unapproved commands with root privileges and disable NOPASSWD options where unnecessary.
Configure sudo timestamp timeouts and caching parameters to minimize the window for sudo abuse.
Restrict privilege elevation capabilities and review administrative rights assigned to user accounts.
reasoning: The adversarial reviewer confirmed privilege escalation via sudo (T1548.003) by user jwilkinson on intranet-server. Immediate containment is warranted to prevent unauthorized root actions and further lateral movement.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (172.26.243.167) to contain potential lateral movement. 2. Terminate active sessions and temporarily disable the jwilkinson account. 3. Audit /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d/ files on the host to remove unauthorized or overly permissive sudo entries. 4. Review authentication logs and root command history to identify any actions taken post-elevation. 5. Invalidate active authentication tokens and reset credentials for the jwilkinson account.
